type:
∀ {n K T : ℕ} (h : TomographyOracleCore.ChoKimBlockCondition n K),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (hT : 0 < T),
      let D := 2 ^ n;
      have design :=
        TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.constantMatrixPOVMPhysicalDesign
          (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T;
      ∃ estimator,
        estimator = TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.dimensionRationalPhysicalEstimator h hT ∧
          ∀ (alpha L : ℝ),
            1 < alpha →
              1 ≤ L →
                0 < TomographyOracleCore.sharpDecayLowerConstant alpha ∧
                  0 < TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.certifiedUpperConstant ∧
                    ENNReal.ofReal
                          (TomographyOracleCore.sharpDecayLowerConstant alpha *
                            TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayMinimaxRate D (↑T) L alpha) ≤
                        TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                          (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass D alpha L) ∧
                      TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                            (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass D alpha L) ≤
                          TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.fixedRisk
                            (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass D alpha L)
                            (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalPOVM.RandomizedNonadaptiveDesign.toOperator design) ∧
                        TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.fixedRisk
                              (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass D alpha L)
                              (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalPOVM.RandomizedNonadaptiveDesign.toOperator design) ≤
                            TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.classWorstCaseRisk D T alpha L design estimator ∧
                          TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.classWorstCaseRisk D T alpha L design estimator ≤
                            ENNReal.ofReal
                              (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.certifiedUpperConstant *
                                TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayMinimaxRate D (↑T) L alpha)
name: TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.theorem3

type:
∀ {n K T : ℕ} (h : TomographyOracleCore.ChoKimBlockCondition n K),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (hT : 0 < T),
      have gamma := ↑(TomographyOracleCore.Revision.MatrixSolver.statisticalRationalTolerance (2 ^ n) T);
      0 < gamma ∧
        gamma ≤ Min.min 1 √(↑(2 ^ n) / ↑T) ∧
          ∀ (Q : Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ)
            (sigma : TomographyOracleCore.MatrixReduction.DensityOperator (Fin (2 ^ n))),
            TomographyOracleCore.Revision.PhysicalMinimax.forwardObjective
                (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicTwoLayerCliffordUnitaryFin ⋯) Q
                (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.MatrixSolver.guardedDimensionRationalPeriodicSolve n K T ⋯ hT Q) ≤
              TomographyOracleCore.Revision.PhysicalMinimax.forwardObjective
                  (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicTwoLayerCliffordUnitaryFin ⋯) Q sigma +
                gamma
name: TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.theorem3_solver_fit

type:
∀ {n K T : ℕ} (h : TomographyOracleCore.ChoKimBlockCondition n K),
  0 < n →
    0 < T →
      ∀
        (estimate :
          (Fin T → Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n)) ℂ) →
            TomographyOracleCore.MatrixReduction.DensityOperator (Fin (2 ^ n)))
        (hmeas : Measurable estimate),
        (∀ (rho : TomographyOracleCore.MatrixReduction.DensityOperator (Fin (2 ^ n))),
            ∀ᵐ (sample :
              Fin T →
                Matrix (Fin (2 ^ n)) (Fin (2 ^ n))
                  ℂ) ∂TomographyOracleCore.Revision.PhysicalMinimax.periodicSampleLaw h T rho,
              TomographyOracleCore.MWPLS.HasFirstOrderCertificate
                (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicTwoLayerCliffordUnitaryFin ⋯)
                (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.PhysicalMinimax.empiricalForwardMatrix sample) (estimate sample)
                (Min.min 1 (↑(2 ^ n) / ↑T))) →
          ∀ (alpha L : ℝ),
            1 < alpha →
              1 ≤ L →
                have design :=
                  TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.constantMatrixPOVMPhysicalDesign
                    (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T;
                have estimator :=
                  TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.mw_record_physical_estimator ⋯
                    (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicTwoLayerCliffordUnitaryFin ⋯) T estimate hmeas;
                ENNReal.ofReal
                      (TomographyOracleCore.sharpDecayLowerConstant alpha *
                        TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayMinimaxRate (2 ^ n) (↑T) L alpha) ≤
                    TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                      (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass (2 ^ n) alpha L) ∧
                  TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                        (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass (2 ^ n) alpha L) ≤
                      TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.fixedRisk
                        (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass (2 ^ n) alpha L)
                        (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalPOVM.RandomizedNonadaptiveDesign.toOperator design) ∧
                    TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.fixedRisk
                          (TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayClass (2 ^ n) alpha L)
                          (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalPOVM.RandomizedNonadaptiveDesign.toOperator design) ≤
                        TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.classWorstCaseRisk (2 ^ n) T alpha L design estimator ∧
                      TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.classWorstCaseRisk (2 ^ n) T alpha L design estimator ≤
                        ENNReal.ofReal
                          (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.mwRecordSpectralConstant *
                            TomographyOracleCore.spectralDecayMinimaxRate (2 ^ n) (↑T) L alpha)
name: TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.theorem3_mw_record

type:
∀ {n K T r : ℕ} (h : TomographyOracleCore.ChoKimBlockCondition n K),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (hT : 0 < T),
      1 ≤ r →
        r ≤ 2 ^ n →
          ENNReal.ofReal
                (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.unconditionalRankLowerConstant *
                  TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.rankRate (2 ^ n) T r) ≤
              TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.rankClass (2 ^ n) r) ∧
            TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.minimaxRisk
                  (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.rankClass (2 ^ n) r) ≤
                TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.rankClassWorstCaseRisk (2 ^ n) T r
                  (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.constantMatrixPOVMPhysicalDesign
                    (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T)
                  (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.dimensionRationalPhysicalEstimator h hT) ∧
              TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.rankClassWorstCaseRisk (2 ^ n) T r
                  (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.constantMatrixPOVMPhysicalDesign
                    (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T)
                  (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.dimensionRationalPhysicalEstimator h hT) ≤
                ENNReal.ofReal
                  (Min.min 2
                    (TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.certifiedRankUpperConstant * ↑r *
                      √(↑(2 ^ n) / ↑T)))
name: TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.ExactMain.corollary4

                            (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T)
                          (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.mw_record_physical_estimator ⋯
                            (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicTwoLayerCliffordUnitaryFin ⋯) T estimate hmeas) ∧
                      TomographyOracleCore.Revision.ConstantEndpoints.rankClassWorstCaseRisk (2 ^ n) T r
                          (TomographyOracleCore.PhysicalRisk.constantMatrixPOVMPhysicalDesign
                            (TomographyOracleCore.choKimPeriodicFiniteUnitaryProjectivePOVM ⋯) T)
                          (TomographyOracleCore.PaperMatch.RankMinimax.mw_record_physical_estimator ⋯
